eventRows.note: Rakshasa wants to eat them. Roleplay, then pick.

victoryRows.speaker: Rakshasa
victoryRows.text: How could a mere mortal be so strong...?!

victoryRows.speaker: Rakshasa
victoryRows.text: Lord Fafnir... you have doomed me...!

victoryRows.speaker: Rakshasa
victoryRows.text: You... You promised I would never go hungry again...!

victoryRows.speaker: Fafnir
victoryRows.text: Rakshasa... Thou art naught but a gluttonous swine, forever wallowing in thine own insatiable hunger.

victoryRows.speaker: Fafnir
victoryRows.text: Yet that bottomless stomach of thine... may prove most useful to me.

victoryRows.speaker: Fafnir
victoryRows.text: Those who dare trespass upon these mountains... and those for whom I have no further use...

victoryRows.speaker: Fafnir
victoryRows.text: Thou mayst devour them to thy heart's content.

victoryRows.speaker: Fafnir
victoryRows.text: Indeed. Serve me faithfully, and I shall grant thee a feast to last a thousand years.

victoryRows.speaker: Fafnir
victoryRows.text: Heh heh heh... What finer fate could there be for such a ravenous beast?

victoryRows.speaker: Fafnir
victoryRows.text: Thou shalt guard my mountains... and I shall see that thy belly is never empty.

victoryRows.speaker: Rakshasa
victoryRows.text: GRRR...! But now... what am I supposed to eat...?!

rows.speaker: Rakshasa
rows.text: GRRR! Do not look down upon me, mortals!!

rows.speaker: Rakshasa
rows.text: I am Rakshasa... DEMI-GOD OF THIS PIT!!

rows.speaker: Rakshasa
rows.text: GRRR...! You think I need your pity...?!

victoryRows.note: Free narration: the party answers Rakshasa. Roleplay freely, then Continue.
How does he leave? Pick the ending that fits what the table did (Neutral if unsure).

rows.speaker: Rakshasa
rows.text: But... perhaps there is other food...

rows.speaker: Rakshasa
rows.text: I WILL DEVOUR YOU NEXT TIME!!

rows.speaker: Rakshasa
rows.text: Lord Fafnir... she will be angry...!

rows.speaker: Rakshasa
rows.text: No... No, no...! I must go!!

rows.speaker: Rakshasa
rows.text: I am leaving... Don't follow me...!

defeatRows.note: Free narration: the party lost to Rakshasa. Narrate what happens next, then continue.
